text: The 2025 loss area is classified as native forest by the MGAP forest map 2021. This source indicates that out of the 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss observed by Hansen GFC, 13.1 hectares are identified as native forest, with only 0.4 hectares outside mapped forest and no planted forest detected. The MGAP forest map provides the territorial context, confirming the native forest status of the area where the loss occurred.
